page.overview:
What is Bok Yost's ship?

In 0 ABY, Bok Yost's ship, which was equipped with an engine, traveled where the Hand of Judgment stormtrooper deserter group was held prisoner by its owner, the Chancellor of Elegasso, Bok Yost.

Unbeknowst to Yost, the Emperor's Hand Mara Jade secretly boarded his ship as well and managed to hear where Yost and his mercenaries where holding Korlo Brightwater, one of the stormtroopers they captured.

Yost's ship was mentioned in the 2011 novel Choices of One, written by Timothy Zahn.
